create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ and __call__ for a custom model
implement_pipeline_call: implement the __call__ method in a Pipeline subclass to process model inputs
raise_pipeline_exception: raise a PipelineException when a pipeline operation fails during inference
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand the required interface for subclasses
refactor_pipeline_subclass: refactor an existing Pipeline subclass to accept additional parameters in __init__
